description: Represents the computational processing applied to data from a sequencing experiment, or from another analysis. This can be described at the level of individual analysis steps in a workflow/pipeline, or more generally for the workflow/pipeline as a whole. Boundary with TrackProvenance: TrackProvenance (Layer 2) carries faceted, closed-vocabulary descriptors of what was done to the CONTENT (read selection, filtering, normalization, ...); Analysis is the record of the ACTIVITY itself (workflow, tool, version, inputs). Complementary, not competing.

analysis_external_id.description: External, globally unique identifier for the analysis.

analysis_id.description: Internal identifier for the analysis (unique within the metadata deposit).

analysis_input_sources.description: External or internal references to the data sources used as input to the analysis.

analysis_label.description: A human-readable description of the analysis, short enough to be used for listings within software user interfaces, tables, illustration legends, etc.

analysis_main_tool.description: Main software tool used for the analysis.

analysis_main_tool_version.description: Version of the main software tool used for the analysis.

analysis_protocol.description: Document describing the analysis protocol that was followed.

analysis_study_ref.description: Internal reference to the study within which the analysis has been carried out.

analysis_type.description: The type of analysis carried out.

analysis_workflow.description: External reference to the analysis workflow, with availability in at least one machine-operable form (e.g. CWL, Nextflow, ...).

title: Analysis
